title: Bug 648781: check the party identifier that the PEPPOL export will use
summary: PEPPOL validation now uses the same party identifier provider as export to ensure EndpointID is never empty, fixing cases where validation passed but export created invalid documents.
key_points: Validation now asks the same party info provider that export uses and checks that the EndpointID is not empty
The provider is read from PEPPOL 3.0 Setup instead of being hardcoded, so SE can plug in its own provider
Releasing a purchase order is now validated because a Purchase Header branch was added
Reminders and finance charge memos get the same EndpointID check
Documents that would have exported an empty EndpointID now fail validation, with a message that names the setting to change
quote: Validation now asks the same party info provider that export uses and just checks the answer is not empty.
